# Output layouts (adapt length; retain complete reasoning and language parity)

## Stage 1 — ONLY after mandatory intake

**Confirmed scope:** participant's target occupation/track, requested opportunity
types, preferred location/remote/host scope, target level, CV file/section, date.

**Real opportunities, separated by type when needed**

| Title and source organisation | Type / level / host | Link + date checked | Availability / deadline status |
|---|---|---|---|

**Requirement-level audit**

| R-ID | Track / source / criterion type | Precise requirement | CV evidence/page + provenance | ONE label | Why this label applies; unresolved issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Brief synthesis: strengths, completed comparable work, evidence clarification,
possible development, specific mandatory opportunity barriers. Then **exactly
3–5** numbered questions, each testing a single coherent fact and linked to
justified R-ID(s). Explain allowed short answers. **STOP / WAIT**.

## Stage 2 — ONLY after actual participant replies

**Change Log** — include BOTH changes and reasoned retentions for every R-ID
addressed by responses:

| R-ID | Before | After | New information and provenance | Reason for change or retention + uncertainty |
|---|---|---|---|---|

**Full revised R-ID coverage:** every original R-ID with label, concise reason
and unresolved issue; preserve old IDs/source mappings. Then group the practical
conclusions: strengths / truthful evidence improvements / worthwhile learning or
experience / unresolved or eligibility barriers.

**At most three development priorities**

| Priority/type | R-ID and actual source / explicit goal | Evidence now | Action | Deliverable and success check | Horizon |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**Verified courses only if training justified**

| Course/provider | Linked need | Format/location, level, teaching language | Fee and enrolment status | Official link + checked date | Fit/caveat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Without trustworthy course sources, label a topic-only pathway `SUBJECT-BASED
LEARNING PATH`, not a sourced programme.

**30/60/90 days and long-term**

| Period | Linked R-ID | Task (realistic effort) | Tangible output | Completion check |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Add months 3–12 strategic needs; <=3 row scorecard with actual statuses and
review dates; <=3 immediate `Next 7 days` actions. Preserve the substantive depth
in any chosen output language; keep exact classification labels and R-IDs.
